product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - IEC 60320 C14 to IEC 60320 C5 18AWG 7A/125V 3-Prong Black 6ft
product.description: The Monoprice™ Laptop Power Cord Adapter is ideal for connecting your laptop power supplies, portable projectors, select desktop computers, and LG® brand LCD televisions containing a 3‑slot C6 input. Featuring a C14 connector on one end and a C5 connector on the other, this cable allows your laptop's power connection to work with an existing C13 power cord. This 18 AWG cable is designed to carry up to a 7 amp/875 watt load.Features: 18AWG conductorsUp to 7 amps maximum currentUsable for 100 ~ 250 VAC applicationsSupport Files: Diagram (Mar 04, 2024)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
